evidence.text: Eagle County Regional Airport (IATA: EGE, ICAO: KEGE, FAA LID: EGE) (Vail/Eagle Airport or the Eagle Vail Airport) is four miles (6 km) west of Eagle, Colorado.

evidence.title: Eagle County Regional Airport
evidence.text: The airport serves its namesake Eagle County, which includes visitors to the nearby Vail and Beaver Creek ski resorts.

evidence.title: Eagle County Regional Airport
evidence.text: It covers 632 acre and has one runway.
